en.r: Montanhas de Guadalupe National Park is a national park in Texas, United States. It covers 366 km² and has been protected since 1972. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.
en.h: El Capitan was a landmark for travellers on the Butterfield stagecoach route; a station's ruins stand near Pine Springs. The Mescalero Apache lived in the mountains. Petroleum geologist Wallace Pratt donated McKittrick Canyon. The park opened on 30 September 1972.
en.ff: The mountains are part of the Capitan fossil reef from the Permian sea, one of the best preserved in the world. Guadalupe Peak (2,667 m) is the highest point in Texas. Pine and maple forests in the canyons contrast with the Chihuahuan Desert.

en.r: Palo Duro Canyon State Park is a state park in Texas, United States. It covers 118 km² and has been protected since 1934. It is managed by the state government.
en.h: A 28,000-acre (11,000 ha) state park in Randall and Armstrong counties, Texas, opened in 1934 and named for Palo Duro Canyon, which runs through it. A team under Captain Randolph B. Marcy mapped the canyon in 1852 while searching for the headwaters of the Red River. The land stayed under Native control until 1874, when Colonel Ranald S. Mackenzie's expedition captured and slaughtered about 1,200 horses in the Battle of Palo Duro Canyon, and the Comanche and Kiowa left. In 1876 Charles Goodnight set up a ranch there.

en.r: Meridian State Park is a state park in Texas, United States. It covers 2.1 km² and has been protected since 1935.

pt.r: O Post Oak Ridge State Park é um parque estadual no Texas, nos Estados Unidos. Está protegido desde 2026.
pt.h: Parque estadual de 1.262 ha nos condados de Burnet e Lampasas, no Texas Hill Country, do outro lado do rio Colorado em relação ao Colorado Bend State Park. O estado comprou a terra em 2025, e o parque abriu para uso diurno em 24 de setembro de 2026; o pernoite está previsto para 2029. A paisagem é de savana de carvalhos e pradaria, com bosques de carvalho-post e o riacho Yancey, alimentado por fontes.
pt.ff: Um primeiro inventário registrou rã-leopardo-do-rio-grande, mocassim-d'água, lagarto-de-colar, escinco-marrom, cobra-d'água-de-ventre-liso, peixe-mosquito-ocidental e tetra-do-texas.

en.r: Post Oak Ridge State Park is a state park in Texas, United States. It has been protected since 2026.
en.h: A 1,262 ha state park in Burnet and Lampasas counties, in the Texas Hill Country, just across the Colorado River from Colorado Bend State Park. The state acquired the land in 2025, and the park opened for day use on 24 September 2026; overnight access is scheduled for 2029. The landscape is oak savanna and prairie, with post oak woodlands and the spring-fed Yancey Creek.
en.ff: An early inventory logged Rio Grande leopard frog, cottonmouth, common collared lizard, little brown skink, plain-bellied water snake, western mosquitofish and Texas tetra.
